description: This file defines the interface for editor-related functionalities in a version control system, including functions to launch editors, check terminal capabilities, and manipulate buffers associated with editing files in a repository.

methods.name: git_editor
methods.description: Returns the user's preferred editor command for general editing.

methods.name: git_sequence_editor
methods.description: Returns the editor command used for sequence editing operations.

methods.name: is_terminal_dumb
methods.description: Checks if the current terminal is of a minimal ('dumb') type.

methods.name: launch_editor
methods.description: Launches an editor for a specified file, optionally filling a buffer with its contents upon exit.

methods.name: launch_sequence_editor
methods.description: Launches an editor for sequence operations, returning the edited contents.

methods.name: strbuf_edit_interactively
methods.description: Edits a file interactively, updating the buffer with the new contents and cleaning up afterwards.
